# Varnam Invites

Varnam Invites (varnaminvites.store) is India's leading ultra-premium, interactive, and cinematic digital wedding invitation platform. It allows users to create bespoke, luxury-tier digital wedding e-invites shareable with a single link on WhatsApp, SMS, or email.

## Main Pages

- [Home Page](https://www.varnaminvites.store/) - Premium cinematic digital wedding invitations with RSVP tracker.
- [Templates Gallery](https://www.varnaminvites.store/templates) - Handcrafted templates collection featuring Classic and Premium cinematic digital wedding invitations.
- [Sign In / Studio Access](https://www.varnaminvites.store/login) - Wedding studio sign in for couples to customize invites and track live guest RSVPs.
- [About Us](https://www.varnaminvites.store/about) - The story, craftsmanship, and technology behind Varnam Invites.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.varnaminvites.store/privacy-policy) - Privacy and security guidelines.
- [Terms of Service](https://www.varnaminvites.store/terms-of-service) - Licensing terms and conditions.

## Key Features

- **Cinematic Entrance Animations**: Lotus archways, temple pillars, heritage doorways, and scratch-to-reveal cards with falling petals.
- **Dynamic RSVP Tracking**: Online RSVP management with attendance logs, guest counts, and guest wish boards.
- **Event Information & Schedules**: Interactive multi-event schedules with dress code specifications, transit instructions, and active directions.
- **Media & Slideshow Integration**: Customized background image uploads, photo slideshow galleries, and support for elegant background music tracks.
- **No App Required**: Built on modern web technologies ensuring compatibility across any mobile and desktop browser.

## Pricing

- [Pricing Details](https://www.varnaminvites.store/#pricing) - Transparent event licensing: Classic tier at ₹999, Premium tier at ₹1,199. Free drafting and preview, pay only to activate your live link.

## Templates Collection

1. [Rose Classic](https://www.varnaminvites.store/templates/rose-classic) - Regal romance classic wedding invitation featuring grand chandelier floral archway, delicate blush roses, gold foil scratch-to-reveal card, and antique parchment program.
2. [Red Classic](https://www.varnaminvites.store/templates/red-classic) - Regal temple classic wedding invitation featuring sacred Lord Ganesha archway, royal gold mandala date reveal, and rich crimson red textures.
3. [Mayura Classic](https://www.varnaminvites.store/templates/mayura-classic) - Regal peacock classic wedding invitation featuring carved palace jharokha archway, gold mandala sunburst timeline, and jewel-toned peacock plumes.
4. [Palace Garden](https://www.varnaminvites.store/templates/palace-garden) - Regal palace garden wedding invitation featuring carved marble jharokha, blue hydrangeas, crystal chandelier, and royal peacock motifs.
5. [Crimson Red](https://www.varnaminvites.store/templates/crimson-red) - Minimalist royal crimson wedding invitation framed with golden lotus archway, elegant typography, and smooth scroll motion.
6. [Lotus & Swans](https://www.varnaminvites.store/templates/lotus-swans) - Serene sacred water wedding invitation adorned with royal swans, floating lotus blossoms, and traditional hanging bells.
7. [Marigold Festive](https://www.varnaminvites.store/templates/marigold-festive) - Joyous celebration adorned with cascading marigold garlands, peacock archway motifs, and glowing terracotta lamps.
8. [Classical Gold](https://www.varnaminvites.store/templates/classical-gold) - Graceful classical wedding invitation adorned with royal gold filigree archway, divine Veena and Mridangam melodies.
9. [Temple Heritage](https://www.varnaminvites.store/templates/temple-heritage) - Grand temple wedding invitation featuring carved stone architecture, sacred oil lamps, and cinematic gold foil reveal.
10. [Royal Palace](https://www.varnaminvites.store/templates/royal-palace) - Palace mandapam wedding invitation with carved heritage pillars, traditional scroll timeline, and gold filigree animations.
11. [Heritage Courtyard](https://www.varnaminvites.store/templates/heritage-courtyard) - River heritage wedding invitation featuring ancestral wooden doorway reveal, brass deepams, and festive courtyard celebration.
